title: RSE 11/12: Occultation where + global search (swe_lun_occult_where + swe_lun_occult_when_glob)
description:
### Summary
Port the Moon-occults-a-planet/star functions `swe_lun_occult_where` (occultation shadow geometry, delegates to `eclipse_where` with the occulted body) and `swe_lun_occult_when_glob` (global search for the next/previous occultation). Exposes `Ephemeris::lun_occult_where` and `lun_occult_when_glob` (`&self`).

Depends on **RSE 5** (`eclipse_where`, `calc_planet_star`, types — occultation reuses them with `ipl`/`starname` = occulted body) and **RSE 7** (the solar `when_glob` established the search/refinement scaffolding this parallels).

### Files
- `src/eclipse.rs` — add the body-radius resolution helper (point source for a star, apparent disc for a planet — flagged in the doc as duplicated 4× in C; consolidate into ONE shared `fn source_radius(&self, ipl, starname, ...)`), `lun_occult_where`, `OccultGlobal` result, `lun_occult_when_glob`.
- `src/context.rs` — `pub fn lun_occult_where(&self, tjd_ut, body: Body, starname: Option<&str>, ifl: CalcFlags) -> Result<EclipseWhere, Error>` and `pub fn lun_occult_when_glob(&self, tjd_start, body: Body, starname: Option<&str>, ifl: CalcFlags, ifltype: EclipseFlags, backward: bool) -> Result<OccultGlobal, Error>`.
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export `OccultGlobal`.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_eclipse.c` — add keys `occ_where` + `occ_when_glob`; regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- `tests/golden/eclipse.rs` — add `#[test] occ_where` + `#[test] occ_when_glob`.

### Implementation steps
Read `docs/c-ref-occultation.md` §1 (`swe_lun_occult_where`), §2 (`swe_lun_occult_when_glob`), and cross-referenced sections of `docs/c-ref-eclipse-solar.md` (§3 eclipse_where, §5 when_glob, §7 find helpers).

1. **Body-radius resolution** (occultation.md §1 "Radius handling"): a fixed star is a POINT source (radius 0); a planet has an apparent disc from the `pla_diam[]` table (values in the doc). Consolidate the C's 4×-duplicated branch into one helper. STATELESS NOTE: C reads `swed.ast_diam` global for asteroid diameters — thread it explicitly or take the disc from a constant table; the doc flags this.
2. **`lun_occult_where`** (§1): thin wrapper over `eclipse_where` (RSE 5) with the occulted body = `body`/`starname` instead of the Sun; asteroid-134340→Pluto aliasing; `SE_ECL_ONE_TRY` behaviour. Returns `EclipseWhere` (same struct as solar).
3. **`OccultGlobal`** result: `tret[0..10]` per §2; type bitmask.
4. **`lun_occult_when_glob`** (§2): the search DELTA from solar `when_glob` — rough-conjunction `dl/13` bracketing (the Moon's motion dominates; step in §2), latitude-gate rejection, `find_maximum` refinement with `dtdiv=3` (NOT solar's 4), ipl-dependent annular-type validity/rejection, `starname` vs `ipl` selecting the fixed-star vs planet path via `calc_planet_star`. `backward` flips direction.

### C reference
`docs/c-ref-occultation.md` §1, §2; `docs/c-ref-eclipse-solar.md` §3, §5, §7 (shared machinery).

### Golden tests
- **C harness** add key `occ_where`: for a known occultation, e.g. Moon occulting Venus/Mars/Aldebaran — `tjd_ut ∈ {2458800.5}`, `(ipl, starname) ∈ {(SE_VENUS,NULL), (SE_MARS,NULL), (-1,"Aldebaran")}` → `swe_lun_occult_where(tjd_ut, ipl, starname, SEFLG_MOSEPH, geopos, attr, serr)`. Emit `{tjd_ut, ipl, starname, retval, geopos:[0..10], attr:[0..10]}`. Add key `occ_when_glob`: `tjd_start ∈ {2451545.0}`, `(ipl,starname)` same set, `backward ∈ {0,1}`, `ifltype=0` → `swe_lun_occult_when_glob(...)`. Emit `{tjd_start, ipl, starname, backward, retval, tret:[0..10]}`. Regenerate `eclipse.json`.
- **Rust tests** `#[test] occ_where` + `#[test] occ_when_glob`: assert `geopos`/`attr`/`tret` via `assert_f64_eps(.., 1e-5)` (`occ_where` geometry 1e-7); assert returned flags == `retval`. Star cases require the fixstar catalog loaded (same setup as `tests/golden/fixstar.rs`).
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::occ_where -- --nocapture` and `eclipse::occ_when_glob` pass.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo build` + `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean.
- `cargo test --test golden eclipse::occ_where` and `eclipse::occ_when_glob` pass.

### Escape hatch
If results fail > 1e-4 day (times) / 1e-6 (where) after two attempts, STOP and report failing `(ipl/starname, epoch, backward)` + diverging slot. Read `swecl.c:606–630` and `1572–1984` directly. Escalate to Opus after two attempts.
execution_record:
Implemented per the task's embedded plan (no separate vidhi-plan needed) using docs/c-ref-occultation.md + docs/c-ref-eclipse-solar.md. Reused eclipse_where/calc_planet_star/body_radius_au unchanged from the solar port.

Divergences found by reading swecl.c directly (the ref doc's abstraction didn't pin these):
- occultation's `dtb` for contact-time secant refinement is NOT divided by 3, unlike solar's `dtb = tenmin/3.0` (swecl.c:1843 vs 1386) — literal C asymmetry, preserved.
- occultation's ifltype bare-type expansion (`ifltype & (TOTAL|ANNULAR|ANNULAR_TOTAL)`) uses bitwise-AND, unlike solar's exact `==` equality test at the same point (swecl.c:1640 vs 1234) — also preserved as a literal divergence.
- occultation lacks solar's second initial validation check (`ANNULAR_TOTAL|NONCENTRAL` exact-match error) entirely.
- C's `eclipse_where` is called twice with identical arguments to confirm-then-classify (unlike solar, which uses eclipse_where+eclipse_how, two different functions); since eclipse_where is pure and `tjd` doesn't change between the calls, collapsed into one reused result — this also makes C's dead "extremely small percentage" fallback branch provably unreachable.
- Did not replicate C's `if (ipl<0) ipl=0` raw-int sentinel clamp for star-only calls; used `starname` presence directly to gate the Sun-only annular/hybrid validity check instead, since Body/Option<&str> already carries that distinction cleanly.
- No SE_ECL_ONE_TRY support exposed, matching the precedent already set by sol_eclipse_when_glob's bool-only backward param.

gen_eclipse.c required two fixes beyond the new keys: (1) swe_fixstar (reached via calc_planet_star) strcpy()s into its starname argument in place — passing a string-literal pointer segfaulted; fixed by copying into a local char[AS_MAXCH] buffer. (2) swe_set_ephe_path(NULL) doesn't find sefstars.txt; changed to an explicit "../swisseph/ephe" path (existing sol/lun keys use MOSEPH only so this didn't matter before). Both golden tests (occ_where, occ_when_glob) passed on the first Rust implementation attempt once the C generator itself was fixed — no escape-hatch escalation needed.

messages.text: Review (vidhi-review): approve with notes. Faithful, exhaustively-annotated port; occ_where/occ_when_glob golden pass at 1e-7/1e-5, clippy clean. Fixed a dead redundant angle-wrap in the transit secant loop (commit after 2a26a41). Main note: the ifltype filter/validation + asteroid-Pluto aliasing were untested (all golden used ifltype=0) — filed + implemented as swisseph-rs/92, which added coverage and, notably, confirmed the port was CORRECT (the one failure it surfaced was a bug in the new test's golden generator, not in this code).
